issue_request: FHIR-14672 was a Published FHIR-core ValueSet change request from the Vocabulary work group, resolved Persuasive for R5. It asked to clarify ValueSet.date by changing the definition to say the value set metadata or content logical definition (.compose) was created or revised and changing the comment to refer specifically to meta.lastUpdated.

FHIR-14672 refined, rather than reversed, that decision. Confluence Vocabulary tracker minutes for 2021-09-29 and 2021-10-13 aligned with the Jira record. The current comment has an added localization-guidance sentence, but it preserves the FHIR-14672 meta.lastUpdated clarification.
